text:
maria_support: Customer (Acorn) opened a ticket — after IdP rotated signing cert yesterday their users in us-west get 403 on SSO login. They say it started ~09:12 UTC.

maria_support: Our gateway logs show: "SAML validation failed: certificate chain validation error: unable to get local issuer certificate" for their tenant id 1357.

acorn_jones: Confirmed — we rotated keys, everything looked fine on our side. Users intermittently get 403, some succeed.

bob_engineer: Can you grab the raw SAMLResponse for a failing request? We need to decode and check Subject/Issuer + Signature cert thumbprint.

maria_support: Pasted a defanged sample SAMLResponse (base64 truncated):
```
PD94bWwgdmVyc2lvbj0iMS4wIj8+PHNhbWxwOlJlc3BvbnNlIHhtbG5zOnNhbWxwPSJ1cm46Zm9vIiBJc3N1ZXI9Imh0dHBzOi8vYWNvcm4uaW8vaWQvc2VydmVyIj4gPHNpZ25hdHVyZT48Yz4uLi4gPD94..
```

maria_support: Repro steps I ran from support machine:
```
# fetch IdP metadata
curl -sS https://idp.acorn.io/.well-known/saml/metadata | xmllint --format -
# simulate authn request (shortened)
curl -i -X POST "https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs?tenant=1357" --data-urlencode "SAMLResponse=PD..."
```

carla_infra: I checked their metadata — their IdentityProvider descriptor has a new <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> element but also a comment node and an xml:base attribute changed. Some of our metadata watch logic canonicalizes and it looks like the new xml:base + comment ordering caused our metadata checksum to not update so the old cert stayed cached on edges for a bit.

carla_infra: Gateway logs show the edge forwarded the old intermediate cert chain (missing new intermediate) while origin had correct chain. That explains intermittent success.

bob_engineer: Got it. So chain verification fails at edge when validating assertion signature because we don't have the new intermediate in trust store at that layer. Is there evidence of different chains served?

maria_support: Yes — captured two requests within a minute. One returned header: X-IdP-Chain: intermediate-old.pem; later one had X-IdP-Chain: intermediate-new.pem.

carla_infra: Suggested fix: flush metadata cache on watcher and edge CDN cache for tenant 1357. Also update metadata watcher to strip comment nodes before checksum to avoid checksum drift.

maria_support: Performed edge cache purge for tenant 1357 and restarted metadata-watcher (log: watcher picked up metadata change at 2024-04-02T09:16:40Z).

deploybot: deploy/metadata-watcher v2.3.1 rolled to us-west-edges — success.

bob_engineer: After purge/restart, run the same curl test and decode SAMLResponse locally:
```
echo 'PD...' | base64 -d | xmllint --c14n -
```
Check Signature/KeyInfo/X509Data/X509Certificate and thumbprint. Also validate with openssl verify using full chain.

maria_support: Customer re-tested and reports SSO logins succeeding for previously blocked users. They saw no more 403s after 09:18 UTC.

carla_infra: Root cause summary for ticket: IdP rotation included new intermediate and xml:base/comment changes. Our metadata watcher checksum ignored some canonicalization differences and kept serving stale cert chain at some edges during roll. Cold caches produced intermittent failures.

bob_engineer: Action items: (1) Add canonicalization step to metadata watcher to normalize/remove comments before checksum. (2) Add alert when edge chain != origin chain for SAML cert headers. (3) Run a short audit to find other tenants with xml:base/comment changes in last 30 days.

maria_support: I'll update the ticket with repro steps, timeline, and the temporary mitigation (purge + watcher restart) and next steps.

acorn_jones: Thanks — confirmed users can log in now. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

maria_support: Marking as resolved pending follow-up audit.

carla_infra: I'll open a PR for the watcher normalization and link it here.

bob_engineer: Leave this thread open until PR merged and audit complete.
